propositions: CodeQL rule py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data flags five sites in _commands module as logging sensitive data; analysis shows all five are taint over-approximations with no credential material reaching log or stdout.

Alerts 86 and 87 at _seam.py:452 and :512 flag constant detector category names from SECRET_PATTERNS table, not credential values, because SecretFinding dataclass structurally lacks a value field by design.
Alerts 83, 84, 85 at __init__.py flag usage error prints that echo back operator command line; the flagged tainted value is stripped from argv before printing, so it cannot reach the output.

Regression tests pin the invariant: test_the_cli_forced_write_log_names_the_family_and_not_the_secret and test_usage_errors_never_echo_the_override_reason assert no secret value or override reason appears in logs or stderr.
All five alerts were dismissed via code-scanning API with false positive justification and per-alert evidence comments; subsequent scan shows zero open alerts for the rule.
